name: US midterm elections

markets.question: Will Xavier Becerra win the California Governor Election in 2026?
Yes if Xavier Becerra is elected governor of California in 2026; can settle early on a media projection.
Will the Democrats win the Georgia governor race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (Keisha Lance Bottoms) has its candidate inaugurated as governor after the 2026 election; can settle early on a media projection; closes at the swearing-in.
Will the Democrats win the Georgia Senate race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (Jon Ossoff) wins this seat, judged by who is sworn in for the term starting 2027; can settle early on a media projection.
Will the Democrats win the Ohio governor race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (Amy Acton) has its candidate inaugurated as governor after the 2026 election; can settle early on a media projection; closes at the swearing-in.
Will the Democrats win the Ohio Senate race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (Sherrod Brown) wins this seat, judged by who is sworn in for the special-election seat; can settle early on a media projection.
Will the Democrats win the Texas governor race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (Gina Hinojosa) has its candidate inaugurated as governor after the 2026 election; can settle early on a media projection; closes at the swearing-in.
Will the Democrats win the Texas Senate race in 2026?
Yes if the party of the listed nominee (James Talarico) wins this seat, judged by who is sworn in for the term starting 2027; can settle early on a media projection.

notes: Before the count the model's estimate is the past certified results (2024 president / 2022 governor and Senate by county) with its uncertainty; it does not use polls.

Pre-count timeline: every 30 minutes over the last 14 days; pm = Polymarket CLOB price history, kalshi = Kalshi 1-minute candles sampled at each point (mid if spread ≤ 10c, else last trade), P = the model's chance before any votes are counted (constant).
counted = share of the expected two-party vote already counted (model estimate; US feeds report precincts, not remaining ballots).
raw and share are the Democratic share of the Democrat + Republican vote.
Alaska's races are not modelled: under top-four ranked-choice voting several candidates share a party, so party totals do not answer the candidate-specific markets.
kalshi = Kalshi P(Democrat): midpoint of the market's order book when the spread is at most 10c, else empty; market per race from configs/pairs/us2026.toml. Prices © Kalshi.
Model frozen before polls closed (configs/us2026_*_v1.toml); see docs/us_midterms.md.
Polls close (UTC, Nov 4): Georgia 00:00, Ohio 00:30, Texas 01:00 (02:00 in El Paso and Hudspeth counties), California 04:00.
Ohio governor, Ohio Senate (special): county prior not available yet; prices are shown, model fields are empty.
